title: Naseuhat nyang geu-ukir lam hikmah .
intro: Bayangkan gata teudong bak binéh sidroe tokoh nyang jituri kon keuhai mukjizat atawa keurajaan, teuma keuhai kata-kata nyang mantong jibimbéng ate sampoe uroenyoe. Hamba Allah nyoe geuteurimong hadiah nyang meuharga dan geucurah syukur keu tiep-tiep naseuhat nyang geubri keu sidroe aneuk muda nyang geugaséh.
clues: Ulôn neubri beureukat lé Allah deungon hikmah, dan neuyue untôk syukur ateuëh hikmah nyan.
Lon peugah haba ngon aneuk lon deungon naseuhat nyang leumoh, peuingat deungon gaséh sayang dan keuprihatinan.
Lon peugah bak aneuk lon bahwa meusapat ngon Allah nakeuh salah nyang that rayeuk.
Lon naseuhat aneuk lon untuk peudong seumayang, peurintah nyang beutoi, peularang nyang salah, dan beu saba.
Lon peuingat aneuëk ulôn mangat bék jiputa pipi deungon sombong dan bék jijak ateueh bumoe deungon sombong.
Lon peurunoe aneuk lon beu moderat lam laju dan beu geupeutron su, sabab su nyang paleng kreuh na kheueh su keuleudée nyang meu-ulang-ulang.

trial.label: Naseuhat Lon nyang Paleng Rayeuk .
options: Meunasehat aneuk lon bek meusekutu ngon Allah .
Peugot kapai mangat seulamat nibak ie raya .
Meutafsirkan lumpoe penguasa watee lam peunjara
Meuhadap Fir’un deungon tanda-tanda ajaéb .
Teungoh jiteubiet le eungkot rayeuk lam laot .
trial.answer: Meunasehat aneuk lon bek meusekutu ngon Allah .

location.label: Hadiah Geubri Keu Lon

outcome.label: Kiban Ulôn Teuingat .
options: Bak sidroe ureung karam lam ie raya kareuna hana peucaya .
Lagée ureuëng nyang jiteugom lé bumoe sabab sombong .
Seubagoe model rasa teurimong geunaseh dan nasihat ureung chik nyang bijaksana .
Lagée nyang ka hanco lé saboh beureutoh nyang teuga nibak langét .
Bak sidroe ureueng nyang meuubah sabab meulanggeh uroe Sabat .
outcome.answer: Seubagoe model rasa teurimong geunaseh dan nasihat ureung chik nyang bijaksana .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
